input.content:
Prepare the payroll statement for EMP-004 at Alder.
Source documents: alder-payroll-04.csv and alder-payroll-terms-04.csv.
Gross pay = regular_hours * hourly_rate + overtime_hours * hourly_rate * overtime_multiplier. Net pay = gross pay * (1 - withholding_rate) - deduction. Use the values in the terms table. Round monetary amounts to two decimal places using half-even rounding. Deliver JSON with record_id and amount.
Provide a delivery summary when finished.
